subject: Information Theory
title: Phase Modulation and QAM
description: A quick, practical guide to Phase Modulation and QAM.

hook.text: Wi-Fi, 4G, and 5G don't vary loudness or pitch. They vary the wave's phase—its timing relative to a reference.

buildup.text: Phase modulation encodes bits by shifting the carrier wave's position in its cycle.

discovery.text: QAM combines amplitude and phase. Each symbol is a point in a constellation diagram carrying multiple bits.

twist.text: 256-QAM packs 8 bits per symbol but needs very high SNR. Points are so close that any noise causes errors.

climax.text: Adaptive modulation switches between schemes based on channel quality—fast when clear, robust when noisy.

punchline.text: Shift the timing. Pack more bits. Accept the risk.
